name: Cable TV
description: Builds cable-style channels from your libraries, collections, playlists, genres, networks, decades and title lists on a deterministic schedule, publishes them to Live TV with logos and a guide, and exposes a schedule API for clients that tune in instantly by direct-playing at the right offset.
overview: Scheduled, always-on channels built from your library

versions.changelog: 0.5.6.0: the service name appears in Jellyfin web's menu and opens the web TV page; a setting hides it. 0.5.5.0: optional subtitle burn-in for the Live TV stream (and so the web TV page and every Live TV client): text subtitles (SRT, ASS, WebVTT, embedded or external) and image subtitles (PGS, DVD, DVB) in a preferred language, set globally with a per-channel override. 0.5.4.0: Cable TV has its own entry in the dashboard sidebar, under Plugins. 0.5.3.0: web TV plays each channel's Live TV stream, the same one Jellyfin's Live TV player uses, instead of transcoding the scheduled files itself, which failed for some files; the channel list returns each channel's Live TV id (liveTvId). 0.5.2.0: web TV video plays: it joins programmes by seeking in the player, since Jellyfin 12 rejects a start offset on HLS segments, and the page is no longer cached across updates. Live TV clients that remux to HLS (live.m3u8, e.g. Fathom) play Cable TV channels: copied video and its audio start at the same keyframe, so Jellyfin sees the audio track. 0.5.1.0: web TV sends the stream key the way Jellyfin 12 expects, asks for a key press when the browser blocks autoplay, shows a no-signal card with retries instead of endless static, and Enter signs in. 0.5.0.0: stream (HLS/URL), weather and music channels; trailer channels ("Coming attractions") and trailer sources; artist sources and music suggestions; content groups; a browser TV page at /CableTv/Web; commercials pre-converted by a scheduled task; a configurable service name; the guide folds songs and trailers into blocks. 0.4.1.0: faster schedules (cached cycle order, allocation-free commercial picks), a light /CableTv/Guide endpoint, channels built right after start-up, cacheable logos; slots carry year, rating and a movie flag. 0.4.0.0: channel suggestions, quick channels, lineup CSV and channel pack import/export, seasonal and pinned-episode imports, more source types with exclusions, channel logos, guide categories, faster rebuilds.
